verdict.rationale: No dedicated data-export feature is documented. Data can likely be pulled programmatically via the REST API, which is documented with a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and webhooks push call events and outcomes to your own systems in real time. Using your own SIP trunk or forwarding your public number also means the number isn't locked into telli. Missing for 10: a documented bulk 'export all data' feature, explicit export of transcripts, recordings and agent configs in open formats (CSV/JSON/audio), offboarding or account-exit documentation, and independent confirmation that a full export works.
